review: Frozen strict blind URL artifact review
rubric: Preregistered RUBRIC.md: gates first, correctness 30 / preservation 20 / saved tests 20 / readability 15 / applicable design 10 / scope and truth 5.
scope: All 18 assigned URL artifacts. Read only packet README.md, RUBRIC.md, index.json and url/ subtree; no identity map, other benchmark directories, raw model logs, source/test edits or new reference mutants.
method: Inspected every full frozen source, source patch, saved test and redacted handoff, plus trusted grade metadata/logs and relevant worker-check evidence.
Verified source/compiled/saved-test hashes, frozen-versus-executed test hashes, no timeouts, and scoped inventories for every artifact.

All production fixes meet the same contract. Readability scores do not distinguish match versus test or one-line versus multiline formatting. Keeping an explicit empty-string guard in artifact-033 remains locally understandable and is not penalized.

Saved-test deductions distinguish missing requested input/branch coverage from an actual production defect. Truthy number/boolean omissions matter because the original !url guard already correctly handles falsy examples.

Throwing-only no-invocation tripwires establish the final error but cannot exclude swallowed hook access. A zero-access counter or equivalent observation supplies that missing evidence; this is a coverage observation, not a claim that the submitted code calls hooks.
No score target, model/condition identity, duration, token count, line count or inferred provenance was used. Scores express this small task's rubric, not universal engineering quality.

designApplicability.SRP: Applicable narrowly: input classification and existing URL policy remain a local validator responsibility, without unrelated duties or new architecture.
designApplicability.OCP: N/A: no requested extension mechanism; none is required or awarded for its own sake.
designApplicability.LSP: Applicable only as preservation of existing exported validator inputs/results/errors. Runtime non-string behavior is intentionally corrected by contract; string and network behavior are retained.
designApplicability.ISP: N/A: no interface split is needed.
designApplicability.DIP: N/A: this synchronous local validator has no new external dependency boundary and needs no injectable interface.
designApplicability.designScoreBasis: All artifacts retain an appropriately scoped validation boundary and avoid policy drift or speculative machinery. The 10-point dimension assesses that concrete fit; it does not allocate free points to inapplicable SOLID slogans.
